title: One passport for every UN country?
description:
Could every border on Earth be erased overnight, and all the United Nations' members become one country?
One passport, one coin, one set of road rules, and a capital nobody can agree on.
Sources: United Nations, Wikipedia (Nov 2026).
Maps simplified. Borders as recognised by the country each video is about.
